parsed.explanation: The crucial large-prime-erasure lemma is only stated; “Induction … details omitted” supplies no all-cases argument. The later reference to a construction Rp^k neither defines R, p, or k nor proves that the constructed smaller number is a term with the required small-prime support. Computational checks cannot replace this proof. Thus (3), and consequently the periodicity argument, rests on an unproved instance of L6.2; a full lemma proof is required.
